text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... It went horribly, terribly 
wrong...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Like this, becoming like everyone I look 
up to is nothing more than a pipe 
dream..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
choice_data_list:
Your running wasn't bad at all. Don't let 
it get you down.

You won't get any stronger just by 
sighing.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If you stay down... and keep looking at 
the floor, you won't be able to see what's 
ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even the sun might get fed up and look 
away...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
When times are tough, that's when you must 
straighten your back... and stand tall...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We have to keep looking forward, 
don't we?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Moping around won't solve anything... 
...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I've come to realize... painfully well 
just how much skill I'm still lacking.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Please revise my training menu! So that I 
can build the strength I'm currently 
lacking...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I don't care how demanding it is. I will 
see it through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I don't... want to feel that frustration 
ever again!
